source_snapshot.procedure: Enable mirror mode, prove current mirrored ranges and Channel Mode m, then inject mirror_uce at a bracketed address placeholder.
source_snapshot.criteria: Matching OS error, BMC UCE slot, asserted fault light, applicable UEFI slot event and applicable LCD DIMM UCE message.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; delegates injection but cannot establish live address, fatal lifecycle, indicators or recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; live map address, fatal oracle, backup/recovery and restoration required.

old_problem: The bracketed address is non-runnable; controller coverage, mirror topology, Windows oracle, fatal/recovery behavior, physical applicability and integrity/restoration were unbound.
disposition_reason: The exact mirror_uce action and fatal evidence objective are clear. ED-03 permits a fresh owner-approved aligned address from the active map plus platform event/applicability values as runtime configuration; ED-16/18 require one-shot isolation, backup and recovery. By prohibiting the literal placeholder and defining full fatal lifecycle and integrity gates, the review is complete without inventing an address.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 19 and 20 plus same-row DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2424 and preserved exact identity/hashes.
Never execute `0x100004000[mirror range]`; prove one current aligned address belongs to the active mirrored region for the selected controller.
Keep this fatal mirror_uce separate from row-18 service-continuity mirror_failover.
Require authoritative Windows evidence, BMC/UEFI slot identity and applicable front-panel/LCD state through recovery.
No BIOS/mirror change, address selection, injection, reset, power, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Inject one mirror UCE at a proven live mirrored address for every approved controller and verify fatal slot attribution, required indicators, bounded recovery, integrity and configuration restoration.
required_package: Supported mirror population/controller coverage and capacity
Approved BIOS mirror/debug configuration and restoration
Current live mirrored ranges, alignment rule and approved per-controller address
Fatal timing/oracle, backup, independent-console recovery and integrity plan
test_case.test_command: A qualified FAE configures approved mirror mode, captures capacity plus full `mc.addMap()`/`mc.dimminfo()` and proves Channel Mode `m`. Select one freshly approved aligned address inside the current controller's mirrored range; never use the bracketed example literally. Invoke `ei.injectMemError(<approved_mirror_address>, errType='mirror_uce')` once, monitor the outage independently, recover only by the approved state machine, and collect complete Windows/BMC/applicable UEFI/front-panel/LCD, integrity and restoration evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The exact live mirrored target produces the signed fatal mirror-UCE response with correct DIMM/controller attribution and applicable fault-light/LCD/UEFI indications; recovery completes within approved boundaries; memory/data integrity and configured baseline are verified.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires fresh map/address proof, complete controller coverage, exact mirror-UCE severity/slot identity, deterministic indicators, bounded recovery and successful integrity/restoration. Placeholder/stale address, generic UCE, wrong target, missing applicable indication, uncontrolled crash, data corruption or failed recovery is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle backed-up SUT, stable power, independent console and explicit fatal-injection approval.
Re-confirm live address membership/alignment immediately before one injection.
Stop on map mismatch, wrong target, uncontrolled outage, data-integrity concern or wrong indication.
No automatic reset, power cycle, retry or address reuse after topology changes.
expected_evidence: Pre/post BIOS/capacity and full live map with Channel Mode m
Complete one-shot transcript and independent outage/recovery timeline
Windows/BMC slot UCE, applicable UEFI/front-panel/LCD evidence
Integrity, configuration restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve independent console/BMC evidence and follow only the approved fatal-event recovery. Verify boot, memory/data integrity, capacity, mirror state and BIOS baseline before any separately authorized next controller; never auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: The non-runnable placeholder becomes a strict live-map binding; controller sequence, Windows oracle, physical applicability and recovery are explicit runtime-controlled contracts.

blocked.reason: The operation, target resolution, fatal oracle and recovery boundary are defined; topology/address/package inputs gate execution.
